title: Voice Agent Pipeline
subtitle: AI-Driven Conversation Orchestration
techStack: Python, FastAPI, OpenAI Realtime API, Twilio, Redis, PostgreSQL
desc: A voice agent that takes real phone calls and talks back in real time. I built it on FastAPI, WebSockets and the OpenAI Realtime API, and it's running in production with real callers.
bullets: Callers can cut in mid-sentence without breaking the call
The agent checks and updates CRM data while the call is still going

title: Generative Video Pipelines
subtitle: Autonomous Multi-Agent Film Production
techStack: Claude Code, MCP, Remotion, Python, Docker
desc: An AI pipeline that takes a concept and turns it into a rendered video. I built it with Claude Code and MCP servers, and a person reviews the work at set checkpoints before it moves on.
bullets: Orchestrated Claude multi-agent pipelines with Remotion (React) for deterministic rendering
Integrated ElevenLabs, Pexels, and Leonardo-AI via custom MCP instances
